title: The guard refuses a git commit or push that skips git hooks
why: Lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, 23:56 CST Nov 8: a test-author (haiku) made its first commit with `git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null`, which skips every git hook. It amended with hooks on before pushing, so the pushed head ecc7be4d1 (#2156) went through hooks and no harm landed, but nothing refused the bypass. Main's hooks/*.py hold no refusal of `--no-verify` or `core.hooksPath` (triage grep 23:57 CST).
note: Refuse `-c core.hooksPath=<anything>` and `--no-verify` / `-n` on git commit, merge and push. Exempt hooks/mutate_shared.py's own internal worktree add (it sets core.hooksPath for a throwaway tree). Red case first.
